title: Understanding Scattered Forest Search: A Version-Space Perspective on Multi-Turn Program Correction
abstract: arXiv:2604.23989v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In multi-turn program correction, the state-of-the-art method Scattered Forest Search (SFS) has been proposed, employing Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with carefully crafted initial seeds and text-based optimization. However, since SFS integrates multiple components, the effects of each component on performance and the overall behavior of SFS have not been sufficiently analyzed. In this work, we theoretically analyze the refinement process of SFS from the perspective of version spaces in learning theory and clarify its behavior. First, as a basis for the theoretical analysis, we introduce a sequential self-refinement method (Line), which starts from an initial program and repeatedly refines the resulting program. translated_title: 理解分散森林搜索：基于版本空间视角的多轮程序修正
translated_abstract: 在多轮程序修正任务中，最先进的方法——分散森林搜索（SFS）已被提出，该方法采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），并配合精心设计的初始种子和基于文本的优化。然而，由于SFS集成了多个组件，各组件对性能的影响以及SFS的整体行为尚未得到充分分析。在本工作中，我们从学习理论中的版本空间视角对SFS的精炼过程进行理论分析，并阐明其行为。首先，作为理论分析的基础，我们引入了一种顺序自精炼方法，该方法从初始程序出发，并反复对所得程序进行精炼。此外，在Line沿深度方向推进精炼过程的同时，我们引入了修复指令的迭代精炼（IRRI）来捕捉宽度方向上的精炼过程，该方法固定i……
tldr: 本文从学习理论中的版本空间视角对多轮程序修正最先进方法“分散森林搜索”的精炼过程进行了理论分析，并引入顺序自精炼方法Line和修复指令迭代精炼方法IRRI，分别刻画精炼过程在深度和宽度方向上的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically analyzes the refinement process of the state-of-the-art Scattered Forest Search (SFS) method for multi-turn program correction from the perspective of version spaces in learning theory, introducing a sequential self-refinement method called Line and Iterative Refinement of Repair Instructions (IRRI) to characterize refinement along the depth and width directions, respectively.
